function profileLinkAdapter(response, maskedAttrs) {
var json = {
options: []
};
for (var i = 0; i < response.length; i++) {
var option = {},
data = response[i];
option.text = '';
option.attr = {};
if (data.notSelectable) {
option.parent = data.value;
} else {
option.value = data.identifier;
var attr = data.attributesInOrder || [];
maskedAttrs = maskedAttrs || [];
for (var j = 0; j < attr.length; j++) {
option.attr[attr[j]] = data[attr[j]];
if (maskedAttrs.indexOf(attr[j]) < 0) {
option.text += data[attr[j]] + ' ';
}
}
option.text = option.text.trim();
}
json.options.push(option);
}
return json;
}
function getParentValue(list){
var parentElem = document.getElementById(list.getAttribute('data-ddd-parent-link'));
if (!parentElem) {
var prefix = list.name.substring(0, list.name.lastIndexOf('_'));
parentElem = document.getElementById(prefix + '_' + list.getAttribute('data-ddd-parent-link'));
}
var parentValue = '';
if (parentElem){
parentValue = parentElem.options[parentElem.selectedIndex].value || '-999';
}
return parentValue;
}

<script>
let widgetId;
const form = document.getElementById('enterEmailForm');
const hCaptchaDiv = document.createElement("div");
hCaptchaDiv.setAttribute("id", "h-captcha");
hCaptchaDiv.classList.add("h-captcha");
hCaptchaDiv.setAttribute("data-sitekey", "94fee806-5cac-4582-9738-384a0f4ea6f8");
hCaptchaDiv.setAttribute("data-size", "invisible");
form.appendChild(hCaptchaDiv);
// Create a floating div for hCaptcha attribution
const hCaptchaAttribution = document.createElement("div");
hCaptchaAttribution.setAttribute("id", "hCaptcha-attribution");
// Add the close button
const closeButton = document.createElement("span");
closeButton.className = "glyphicons glyphicons-remove-sign";
closeButton.setAttribute("tabindex", "0");
closeButton.setAttribute("role", "button");
closeButton.setAttribute("aria-label", "Close hCaptcha attribution notice");
// Add click and keyboard event handlers
closeButton.onclick = function() {
document.body.removeChild(hCaptchaAttribution);
};
closeButton.onkeydown = function(event) {
if (event.key === "Enter" || event.key === " ") {
event.preventDefault();
document.body.removeChild(hCaptchaAttribution);
}
};
// Create a container for the text
const textContainer = document.createElement("div");
textContainer.innerHTML = 'Protected by hCaptcha <a href="https://www.hcaptcha.com/privacy" target="hca">Privacy</a> | <a href="https://www.hcaptcha.com/terms" target="hca">Terms</a>';
// Append elements in the correct order
hCaptchaAttribution.appendChild(closeButton);
hCaptchaAttribution.appendChild(textContainer);
// Add the div to the body
document.body.appendChild(hCaptchaAttribution);
document.body.classList.add("has-hcaptcha");
// Close button handler
closeButton.onclick = function() {
document.body.removeChild(hCaptchaAttribution);
document.body.classList.remove("has-hcaptcha");
};
// Keyboard handler
closeButton.onkeydown = function(event) {
if (event.key === "Enter" || event.key === " ") {
event.preventDefault();
document.body.removeChild(hCaptchaAttribution);
document.body.classList.remove("has-hcaptcha");
}
};
window.hCaptchaOnLoad = function () {
widgetId = hcaptcha.render('h-captcha', {
'sitekey': '94fee806-5cac-4582-9738-384a0f4ea6f8',
'size': 'invisible',
'callback': function (token) {
const captchaToken = document.createElement("input");
captchaToken.setAttribute("type", "hidden");
captchaToken.setAttribute("name", "h-captcha-response");
captchaToken.setAttribute("value", token);
form.appendChild(captchaToken);
const behaviorType = document.createElement("input");
behaviorType.setAttribute("type", "hidden");
behaviorType.setAttribute("name", "behavior-type");
behaviorType.setAttribute("value", "other");
form.appendChild(behaviorType);
form.submit();
},
'expired-callback': function() {
hcaptcha.reset(widgetId);
},
'error-callback': function() {
hcaptcha.reset(widgetId);
}
});
}
form.addEventListener("submit", (e) => {
e.preventDefault(); //Stops the form from submitting until we can call hcaptcha
if (typeof icimsInvisibleRecaptchaBeforeSubmit === 'undefined' || icimsInvisibleRecaptchaBeforeSubmit()) {
hcaptcha.execute(widgetId);
}
});
</script>
<script async defer>
